stem:
The diagram shows a straight copper wire in a closed loop with a cell and a switch. A compass sits beside the wire.

Imran closes the switch so that electric current flows through the wire.

Which prediction about the compass needle is correct?

options.text: The needle should deflect while current flows in the closed loop.
The needle should deflect even if the switch stays open, because the cell is present.
The needle should not deflect when current flows, because a copper wire is never magnetic.
Opening the switch makes the needle deflect more strongly than closing it.

teacher.key_rationale: A nearby compass needle should deflect when current flows in the conductor. An open switch, copper alone, or opening the switch do not give that prediction.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote circuitikz-free loop with cell, switch, copper wire, and compass.
